q1_issues.issue: The premise conjoins both halves of the copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit — the reified state (Member $u untended)(Experiencer $u $x)(Time $u night) and the flat (Member $x untended) — but dual-emit is an assertion convention, and requiring both forms to match over-constrains the rule so it cannot fire on a KB holding only the flat copular atom.

q2_gaps: extent 'through the night' (a throughout-reading over a day-part): During is licensed only for during/while/throughout and needs two reified eventualities, a duration Measure needs a stated count, so only the bare day-part slot (Time $u night) is available and the 'for the whole night' extent is dropped
notes: go_out is correctly kept whole as a phrasal verb with no genus and no single-word synonym, the extinguished lantern takes Patient as a change-of-state undergoer, and (TimeAtMost e dawn) for "before dawn" matches the instruction set's own example exactly.
